abstract: PURPOSE: A prospective multicenter study was carried out to estimate the treatment outcome of radiotherapy in Stage II seminoma after the application of modern staging and radiotherapy techniques. The lower margin of the iliac field was positioned on the upper rim of the acetabulum to reduce the amount of scattered irradiation to the remaining testicle. METHODS AND MATERIALS: The study was carried out in 25 centers in Germany. Patients with pure seminoma, negative AFP-values, and retroperitoneal lymph node metastases of less than 5 cm in diameter were entered into the study. All patients received a ventrodorsal opposed field irradiation of the para-aortic and the ipsilateral iliac lymph nodes. The fields extended from the top of the 11th thoracic vertebra to the top of the acetabulum. Patients in Stage IIA (lymph nodes <2 cm ) received 30 Gy, and patients with Stage IIB (lymph nodes between 2 and 5 cm) 36 Gy total dose. RESULTS: 39 patients in Stage IIA and 19 patients in Stage IIB were evaluated. After a median observation time of 37 months all patients are alive and disease free. Recurrence free survival in stage IIA was 100%. Two patients in Stage IIB experienced a recurrence 10 and 17 months after the end of radiotherapy. The actuarial recurrence free survival estimate in Stage IIB was 94.1% for 1 year and 87.4% for 2 years. One recurrence in Stage IIB occurred in the mediastinum, one in the mediastinum, and one the lung. Both patients could be salvaged by chemotherapy. There were no pelvic recurrences. The treatment was well tolerated, with nausea being the most common side effect (56.9% Grade 1, 15.5% Grade 2, and 8.6% Grade 3). Diarrhea occurred in 15.5% (Grade 1), 15.5% (Grade 2), and 5.2% (Grade 3) of the patients. CONCLUSIONS: The outcome of para-aortic and ipsilateral iliac irradiation in Stage IIA/B testicular seminoma is excellent with the currently available staging methods and treatment facilities. The treatment is well tolerated. The lower margin of the iliacal field can be placed at the acetabulum.
abstract_ja: 目的：現在の病期分類と放射線療法の手法を用いた場合の病期IIのセミノーマに対する放射線療法の治療成績を推定するための前向き多施設共同研究を行った。腸骨照射野の下縁を寛骨臼の上縁に設定し、残存精巣への散乱線量を減らすことを目的とした。方法と材料：ドイツの25施設で本研究を実施した。純粋セミノーマでAFP値が陰性かつ直径5cm未満の後腹膜リンパ節転移を有する患者を登録した。全患者に、傍大動脈および同側腸骨リンパ節への前後対向照射を行った。照射野は第11胸椎上縁から寛骨臼上縁までとした。病期IIA(リンパ節2cm未満)の患者には30Gy、病期IIB(リンパ節2～5cm)の患者には36Gyの総線量を照射した。結果：病期IIA 39例、病期IIB 19例を評価した。中央値37か月の観察後、全患者が生存し無病であった。病期IIAの無再発生存率は100%であった。病期IIBの2例が放射線療法終了の10か月および17か月後に再発した。病期IIBの無再発生存率推定値は1年で94.1%、2年で87.4%であった。病期IIBの再発は、1例は縦隔、もう1例も縦隔、さらに1例は肺に発生した。2例とも化学療法で救済された。骨盤内再発はなかった。治療はよく忍容された。最も多い有害事象は悪心であり(Grade 1が56.9%、Grade 2が15.5%、Grade 3が8.6%)、下痢はGrade 1が15.5%、Grade 2が15.5%、Grade 3が5.2%の患者に発生した。結論：病期IIA/IIBの精巣セミノーマに対する傍大動脈および同側腸骨照射は、現在利用可能な病期分類法と治療設備を用いれば優れた成績である。治療は忍容性が高い。腸骨照射野の下縁は寛骨臼に設定してよい。
